title: fix: test_soft_generate_keypair and persistent_roundtrip use code as own oracle
description:
In test/wp11_test_pkcs11.c, two tests violate the independent-oracle rule:

1. test_soft_generate_keypair_basic (~line 2256-2268): Signs with C_Sign, only checks that signature length is plausible (>0, <=72). Does not verify the signature is cryptographically valid.

2. test_soft_persistent_roundtrip (~line 2372-2384): Reloads a persisted key, signs with C_Sign, only checks CKR_OK and plausible length.

A keystore corruption bug or signing-path bug that produces a wrong-length-but-valid-looking signature would pass both tests undetected.

Fix: After C_Sign, export the public key via wp11_test_soft_export_pub_x963, then verify the signature using wc_ecc_verify_hash (independent wolfCrypt code path). This turns a length check into a true cryptographic oracle.
